name: wtfm
description: Write The Fine Manual. Writes the half of the documentation code cannot write about itself, and refuses the half that goes stale. One rule: a manual that cannot contradict the code never has to be reconciled with it — so anything derivable from a file in the repo is cited, never copied. What is left is durable by construction: addresses, cross-file invariants, a domain glossary, and numbered decision records. Local traps are written as code comments so they cannot drift. Ships two model-free lints, one for broken citations and one for content that should never have been written. Self-driving: fans work out across subagents from a goal and a ledger, and resumes after a dead session.
